summary: Kevin Hayne died in a fall on Little Bear Peak's Hourglass; SAR reached him after his partner hiked out for help
notes: County not verified; partner hiked out for help; AVSAR 2010 narrative: partner's SPOT 911 signal was never received; Buckley Chinook inserting 5 SAR medics struck the mountain with its rear rotor and crash-landed ~1,500 ft down in a marshy meadow (no serious injuries to Army or AVSAR crew); two Blackhawks recovered the Chinook crew; Hayne's body was secured overnight and recovered June 16 by a 20+ multi-county SAR lowering to Little Bear Lake Gorge, flown out by Blackhawk. Alpine 10-34 (id 34, 2010-06-16 'Assist Alamosa SAR with recovery on Blanca Peak') may document Alpine's role in the same June 16 recovery — kept as a separate row. | Backpacker account merged 2026-09-15 (run 566): corroborates the Tuesday 2010-06-15 date and the iced-over-Hourglass context.
